youtube.title: HVAC Business Owners: Ask ChatGPT Who It Would Hire (Then Fix Your Google Profile)
youtube.description:
HVAC business owner, plumbing or roofing: homeowners are starting to ask ChatGPT who to hire.
On Jobber's owner forum, one owner said at least four people in the last month told them ChatGPT is how they found the company, and they didn't think they'd done anything there to get it.
In a survey of 782 homeowners about heating and cooling companies, 37% said they'd look up reviews through AI tools like ChatGPT, close to Yelp at 38% (survey by myCLEARopinion for BNP Media, owner of ACHR News, Apr to May 2026, 782 homeowners, about HVAC companies; published Oct 20, 2026).
A marketing firm's founder, writing in ACHR News with SearchLight data, says ChatGPT referrals are about 1% of revenue for most contractors but average $11,500 a ticket, and that these tools build their answer from your name, address, phone, website, reviews and Google posts (ACHR News guest column by a marketing firm's founder, Mar 18, 2026, SearchLight data).

What to do this week:
1. Tonight, ask ChatGPT: "Who's the best [your trade] near me?"
2. Not named? Fix your Google profile first: your name, your website, your reviews.
3. Ask again in two weeks.

Send this to whoever runs your Google profile.
